name: GeoNet Volcano Cameras
description: Ingests the GeoNet volcano camera network from images.geonet.org.nz and posts each camera to the map as a sensor point with its field of view and a link to the latest image.

permissions.description: Submits volcano camera points to CloudTAK

schedule.description: Polls the GeoNet volcano camera listing for updated camera positions and image timestamps on a schedule.
